title: [Pre Order] AYN Thor Base 8GB+128GB US$319.79 (~A$460) with PayPal Delivered @ AYN Official Store AliExpress
body:
Deal: [Pre Order] AYN Thor Base 8GB+128GB US$319.79 (~A$460) with PayPal Delivered @ AYN Official Store AliExpress

[straustea] Do be warned, it takes at least a month if not longer for it to arrive. I bought mine on the offical AYN store on Aliexpress on June 1st, then it arrivedd on July 16.
[philmarcracken] do they send it via frikkin submarine or what
[ZZMthesurand] They're made to order, actual delivery takes 1-2 weeks
[Whiplash] This would be the least chinese product then on AE hahaha.
[ZZMthesurand] Yup, bought mine during the TopCashbackUK 35% cashback deal on August 18th, arrived October 7th. Was shipped on the 40th day and arrived on the 50th day. Apparently they've gotten a little bit faster since then but YMMV. But very much worth the wait. I've already finished GTA LCS & VCS, currently playing GTA IV alongside Pokemon FireRed with the Pokedaisy emulator which adds second screen functionality to the earlier single screen Pokemon games
[leeeeeeeeeevi] What happened to TopCashbackUK? I missed the last uncapped deal 😭
[JaiQiBoi] Same, yeah a heap of us missed it. I realised about 2 hours too late. :/
[ViperAMD] They don't allow orders to outside the UK anymore
[aragornelessar] This is the exact item I bought at 35% and didn't track. I had the extra paypal discount too - one use only so I can't use the $65 discount again and only get the $48 one
Total now would be $856 vs $820 for the 16GB/1TB model… but cashback may track now…
I'm also part of Team Ozbargain but I'm only seeing this credit - You'll get AU$47.72 credit after the order is complete. Is that the team credit? Looks about 5% (with Ali-math) and not 10%?
[Herszek] maybe just make a claim. I had plenty of success with getting my money back but it was with topcashback.uk. I assume the backend is simmilar for UK and au branch.
[aragornelessar] Yeah I've put a claim in, but it won't get any traction with the retailer until after 7 days anyway.
[pear] theres a daily cap on the credit and for what it's worth i think there's a very good chance it doesn't ship in a month to get the credit anyway.
Personally cancelled my Thor order in favour of the Retroid Pocket Duo net $250 AUD after everything assuming it ships within a month.
[bhunter101] How will it be $250 when the RRP is $581?
[pear] I meant I bought the RP Duo for $250 after all discounts and cashback not the Thor.
[blake94] @pear: how did you manage $250? even with cashback lowest i could figure out is ~$330?
[pear] @blake94: I'm including the 10% credit as a discount but other than that I believe you're using the $18 over $36 Paypal discount.
I also had a $49 off $269 code for some reason, but the code IFPLPBRT is $40 which is still better than the $35 your probably using.
Those changes should get you to $247.75 USD or about $353 AUD. Then you got the $50 cashback and $40 credit to get to $260.
This should probably have it's own deal tbh but I can't be bothered, insane price if u ask me.
[aragornelessar] Good point… I'll just keep my order in that case. If the original purchase tracks, I'm ahead of my purchase price.. but if I cancel and this one tracks, I'm only ahead $14 or so since it's a $50 cap anyhow.
[RichardL] Basically back to the price it was on release. Cheaper if you stack cashback.
The base model on release was US$299 + ~US$20 Shipping, but has since increased multiple times due to RAM/Storage shortages.
Prices of the AYN Thor Base Model since release (price from their site; not including shipping):
Batch 1: $299
Batch 2: $309
Batch 3: $319
Batch 7 (current batch): $329
[McMaferMur] I see oh well i better start using my n3dsxl more.
Also thor 2nd hand price on ebay is crazy sellers are delusional
[RichardL] Also thor 2nd hand price on ebay is crazy sellers are delusional
I bought mine second hand from eBay, earlier this year before all the price increases.
[19199090] I got a max 16+1tb for 616 from Ali in march 1st, I think that was atl (whatever base costed in that sale). As a bonus mine came in 10 days but I got really lucky, I just made the batch cutoff.
[ce5himm] i am here suggesting people who are interested in the base thor, could also give retroid pocket duo a chance. well if you want something all in one, or this is your only handheld, then thor is more powerful, get it. if you have other powerful handheld, mainly focus on 3ds/ds dual screen, treat the rest as a bonus. duo is very good. i personally sold thor pro, and have a duo on order from aliexpress. also, duo is much cheaper.
[ce5himm] also if the left thumbstick at lower position is a deal breaker to you , then go for thor.
[ce5himm] one more screen, ideal for ds/3ds, also 8gen2 offer significantly higher raw performance. can play demanding PS2, GameCube, and Wii emulation at upscaled resolutions with stable framerates.
556 has longer battery life
[Panama] Just got a Duo, so Imma hold out and see if Thor 2 uses the same new screens. That said great price.
[csi-lk] I’m still waiting for my cashback from the last deal
[Slatox] If I'm after a deal on a Pro-12, am i better off waiting for black Friday?
